be flooded with calls: After the singer announced her free concert, the radio station's phone lines would be flooded with calls all day.
歌手宣布舉辦免費演唱會後，電台的電話線整天接不完。
flood the market: Cheap plastic toys from overseas flood the market every Christmas, making it hard for local shops to compete.
每逢聖誕節，海外的廉價塑膠玩具就充斥市場，讓本地商店難以競爭。
memories flooded back: When I walked into my old elementary school, memories flooded back of the friends I used to play with.
當我走進以前的小學，和昔日玩伴的回憶湧現心頭。
flood the engine: If you press the gas pedal too many times when starting an old car, you may flood the engine with fuel.
發動老車時如果踩太多次油門，可能會讓引擎淹油。
a flood of tears: When she heard that her dog had died, she broke into a flood of tears and could not stop.
聽到她的狗死了，她淚如雨下，怎麼也停不下來。
business flourished: After they started selling their cakes online, their business flourished and they opened two new shops.
他們開始在網路上賣蛋糕之後，生意興隆，又開了兩家新店。
the arts flourished: During that rich and peaceful period, the arts flourished as never before, and many great painters appeared.
在那段富裕和平的時期，藝術空前蓬勃，出現了許多偉大的畫家。
flourish a sword: The pirate captain liked to proudly flourish a sword above his head to frighten his enemies.
海盜船長喜歡得意地在頭上揮舞劍來嚇唬敵人。
children flourish: Teachers believe that children flourish when they feel safe, loved, and free to ask questions.
老師們相信，孩子在感到安全、被愛、能自由發問時才會茁壯成長。
ideas flow: When I walk alone in the park, my ideas flow freely and I can plan my essays easily.
我獨自在公園散步時，靈感源源不絕，能輕鬆構思我的文章。
money flows in: During the Lunar New Year holiday, money flows in quickly for shops that sell snacks and gifts.
農曆新年期間，販賣零食和禮品的商店資金快速湧入。
traffic flows smoothly: Thanks to the new bridge, traffic flows smoothly through the city center even during rush hour.
多虧了新橋，即使在尖峰時段，市中心的交通依然順暢。
go with the flow: Our travel plans kept changing, so we decided to relax and go with the flow for the rest of the trip.
我們的旅行計畫一直變，所以我們決定放輕鬆，剩下的旅程就順其自然。
flow from: Clear, cold water flows from a spring high in the mountains, which is the source of this river.
清澈冰涼的水源自高山上的一處泉水，那就是這條河的源頭。
flush with success: Flush with success after winning the science fair, the team began planning an even bigger project.
贏得科展後因成功而得意的團隊，開始計畫一個更大的專題。
flush the toilet: Please remember to flush the toilet and wash your hands every time you use the bathroom.
每次使用廁所後，請記得沖馬桶並洗手。
flush with anger: His cheeks began to flush with anger when his classmates laughed at his new haircut.
同學嘲笑他的新髮型時，他氣得臉頰開始發紅。
flush out the enemy: The soldiers used thick smoke to flush out the enemy who were hiding deep inside the caves.
士兵用濃煙逼出躲在洞穴深處的敵人。
fly into a rage: The manager would fly into a rage whenever anyone came late to the important Monday meeting.
只要有人在重要的週一會議遲到，經理就會勃然大怒。
fly off the shelves: The new smartphones began to fly off the shelves as soon as the store opened, and they sold out by noon.
新款智慧型手機一開店就被搶購一空，到中午就賣完了。
fly the flag: For many years, she has continued to fly the flag for women's rights at every meeting she attends.
多年來，她在出席的每場會議上都持續捍衛女性權益的立場。
fly in the face of: His claim that the earth is flat seems to fly in the face of all the scientific facts we know.
他說地球是平的，這似乎公然違背了我們所知的所有科學事實。
let fly: When the player broke the rule again, the angry coach let fly at him in front of the whole team.
那名球員再次違規時，憤怒的教練當著全隊的面對他大發雷霆。
foam at the mouth: The sick dog began to foam at the mouth, so its owner rushed it to the animal hospital.
那隻生病的狗開始口吐白沫，所以飼主趕緊把牠送到動物醫院。
foaming waves: The foaming waves left thousands of tiny white bubbles all over the sand after the storm.
暴風雨過後，翻騰的浪花在沙灘上留下成千上萬個白色小泡泡。
the business folded: After losing money for three years, the business folded, and the shop has been empty ever since.
連續虧損三年後，公司倒閉了，那間店面從此一直空著。
fold one's arms: The angry girl would fold her arms across her chest and refuse to say a single word.
那個生氣的女孩會雙手抱胸，一句話也不肯說。
fold under pressure: A good goalkeeper must not fold under pressure, even in the final minutes of a big match.
優秀的守門員即使在重要比賽的最後幾分鐘，也不能頂不住壓力。
fold a sheet: My mother taught me how to fold a sheet neatly into a small square after doing the laundry.
媽媽教我洗完衣服後如何把床單整齊地摺成一個小方塊。
